quote: No pedestrian shall cross a roadway other than in a marked crosswalk or within an unmarked crosswalk in any business district.

activation.condition: Afoot pedestrian completes a roadway crossing in a source-reviewed business district.

exceptions.description: Marked crosswalk or unmarked crosswalk is the stated permitted location alternative.
exceptions.source_clause: other than in a marked crosswalk or within an unmarked crosswalk

judgment_calls_needed.note: Business-district frontage and marked/unmarked crosswalk status require independently reviewed original sources; no worker legal cutoff or verdict.

obligation.description: No pedestrian shall cross a roadway other than in a marked crosswalk or within an unmarked crosswalk in any business district.

timing.description: Observe original road entry, full-body route and opposite-curb exit at 20 Hz.
